senses.gloss:
लुड् C. लोडयति stir up, agitate. — अव rummage,
investigate. आ stir up, agitate, trouble, disturb, rummage, work one's
way through (acc.). समा mix together, mingle with (instr.), stir up
etc. = prec. निस् investigate thoroughly. विप्र, प्रति, वि & सम् stir
up, trouble, disturb, confuse.
